base.$description: Base radius. sm, md, lg and xl derive from it at 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x and 2x.

overlay.$description: Border width for floating overlays (Modal, Select, Combobox, Popover, Sheet). They read as raised shadows, not outlined boxes.

ring.$description: Focus ring: outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--color-brand-border-focus); outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset). Never remove it without a replacement.

width-small.$description: Focus ring width for controls whose box is 16px or less; use the -small variant for checkbox, radio and switch boxes.

offset-small.$description: Focus ring offset for controls whose box is 16px or less; use the -small variant for checkbox, radio and switch boxes.
